Happy path: Co-owner creates wedding → verifies account → creates workspace → invites second co-owner → second co-owner accepts exact-email single-use invite → both co-owners see dashboard
Critical exceptions / rules: Invitation expires/revoked/consumed; invited email mismatch; invitee already ACTIVE or SUSPENDED in another wedding (409); do not consume invitation on conflict. Member invitation create payload remains blocked in API; workspace stays setup-only until exactly two co-owners are active.

Happy path: Co-owner proposes organiser invite → second distinct co-owner approves → invitation sent → invitee accepts → scope is applied
Critical exceptions / rules: No single co-owner can complete invite; custom scopes must be explicit; invitee sees only granted modules/actions.

Happy path: Co-owner proposes candidate → second co-owner approves → candidate becomes sole active Treasurer
Critical exceptions / rules: Exactly one active Treasurer; replacement must be atomic; old Treasurer loses finance actions when change completes. Initial appointment during setup before the second co-owner joins is blocked pending an approved bootstrap sequence.

Happy path: Create task → choose function or General wedding planning → assign multiple members → choose one responsible owner → define mandatory checklist → optionally add dependencies → update status → complete
Critical exceptions / rules: Reject missing responsible owner/checklist/scope; prevent dependency cycles; reopening completed task requires reason. Responsible membership is represented separately from collaborators; when it becomes mandatory (creation versus before active work) requires product approval. Dependency writes and completion checks must be cycle-safe under concurrency.

Happy path: Edit draft → propose publish with immutable snapshot → first co-owner approval → second co-owner approval → publish snapshot to invited guests
Critical exceptions / rules: Guest sees published snapshot only; stale version requires refresh/re-proposal; expired proposal cannot publish.

Happy path: Propose cancellation with reason → dual co-owner approval → publish cancellation state → notify affected guests
Critical exceptions / rules: Do not silently remove RSVP history; guest-facing cancelled state must be clear. API payload and cancellation effects are blocked pending owner approval; preserve RSVP history and guest-visible cancellation state.

Happy path: Invitation-bound guest email OTP -> guest submits correction -> own status/detail view -> co-owner or scoped organiser reviews -> requester cannot self-review -> approve/reject with reason; API list/detail/review operations are defined.
Critical exceptions / rules: Merge is separate and requires dual co-owner approval; audit before/after values.

Happy path: Authorised manager selects guest → target household → confirms transfer → system preserves each guest's RSVP history
Critical exceptions / rules: No bulk RSVP reset; household rollups recalculate after transfer.

Happy path: Guest opens invitation → chooses one function → responds individually → server stores per guest/function → dashboard aggregates
Critical exceptions / rules: Partial household response is valid; extra guest is a separate request; do not create a guest automatically.

Happy path: Expense submitted → policy determines approver → Treasurer approves normal expense → if Treasurer created/is beneficiary, dual co-owner approval is required
Critical exceptions / rules: Show reason for required approval path; prevent self-approval; amounts remain integer paise in backend and display INR.

Happy path: Discover → shortlist → compare quotes → co-owner selects → separately record booking/contract
Critical exceptions / rules: Selection is not booking; quote is not contract; no automatic expense creation.

Happy path: Co-owner proposes UPI destination -> second co-owner approves -> verified guest -> Razorpay UPI-only server-side intent -> provider status remains pending until server verification -> reconciliation/status updates.
Critical exceptions / rules: No redirect/screenshot/manual reference proof; signature/webhook verification, idempotency, replay defense, event deduplication and amount/recipient match. Checkout handoff/refund operations and compliance/account gates remain blocked.

Happy path: Guest opens invitation link → verifies email with OTP → opens only an invited function gallery → uploads up to 5 photos in one upload batch. Co-owner/organiser member uploads are capped at 10 photos per upload batch → technical validation and EXIF stripping → moderation/approval.
Critical exceptions / rules: Accept JPG/JPEG and PNG only, max 5,000,000 bytes per file. Guest batch cap 5; co-owner/organiser cap 10. Verify extension/MIME/signature, strip GPS EXIF, private storage and authorized downloads. Dimensions and storage quota are deferred/unspecified; do not use 6000x6000/24MP/5GB as approved limits.

Happy path: Co-owner proposes cancellation/deletion → second co-owner approves → immediate access revoke → generic notice → asynchronous deletion → tombstone
Critical exceptions / rules: Irreversible confirmation; retention/backup schedule must be legally reviewed; deletion progress must not imply instant physical erasure.

Happy path: Guest uses email OTP delivered by Brevo.
Critical exceptions / rules: Guest authentication decision is approved. Invitation identity resolution and token lifecycle
